name: Automox
summary: Automox is a cloud patching service for Windows, macOS and Linux. Its Patch OS plan costs $1 per endpoint per month on an annual commitment, or buyers can pay monthly with no commitment at a higher rate. Automate Essentials and Automate Enterprise are quoted by sales.

facts.text: One policy, one schedule and one set of rollout rings apply across Windows, macOS and Linux, and the example policy runs the day after Patch Tuesday.
Automox's own pages give third-party catalog sizes of 580+ and 630+ titles, so the exact count is unclear.
Policy Results reports show whether recent patches were deployed, and the FAQ says compliance status updates in real time.
Annual billing saves 25% against paying monthly, and the page does not state the length of the free trial.

plans.name: Patch OS
plans.notes: Annual commitment. OS patching for Windows, macOS and Linux. Monthly pay as you go is also offered, and annual plans save 25%

hiddenCosts: Endpoints added mid-term are billed at the same annualized rate, prorated for the rest of the term.
Automox Resolve is an add-on module with no published price.
Volume discounts start at 200 or more device licenses or multi-year contracts, and purchase orders go through sales.
